sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 556 printed subject rows / 542 family-card identities across 11 sections retain physical Name, Team and Rookie cells, including 200 base numbers, 30 selected rookie-design variation numbers and 203 literal Rookie marks. Dual autographs retain both signer rows and original team values, including different clubs on PDPA-WW. No missing flags or team updates are inferred. All 68 categories retain literal Hobby ratios with unpublished units. Thirty exact guide specifications include 21 base limits and nine named insert/autograph limits; Blue and Green Mini Diamond base entries have no published odds and remain specification-only. Base limits never number rookie design variations or ordinary autographs. The guide announces April 29, 2026 arrival. Damascus has 30 checklist rows versus 31 in the guide, and Paint It has 19 versus 20; no subjects are added. Other numbering ladders remain unverified.
The guide names Blue Mini Diamond /150 and Green Mini Diamond Refractor /99 base parallels absent from the odds sheet; retain specification-only entries with no odds.
The guide describes 31 Damascus and 20 Paint It entries, while the linked checklist prints 30 and 19 respectively. Preserve the official roster without adding subjects.
The full numbering ladders for rookie design variations, ordinary autographs, dual autographs, Super Futures and Nocturnal remain unverified. Base colors never number these families.
The odds header names Hobby but no ratio unit; product-page packs and box contents are separate specifications, not evidence that these ratios are per pack.
The Collector Guide includes unrelated Bowman program names in a generic insert paragraph; these are not imported into the Chrome Black checklist.
